name: Email Campaign
description: Produces a completed email marketing sequence of 3-5 emails with subject lines, body copy, CTAs, and send timing using drip sequence design principles. Use when the user asks to create an email campaign, design a drip sequence, write a welcome series, build a nurture sequence, or plan automated email flows. Do NOT use for single professional email writing (use professional-email in writing), full campaign planning across channels (use campaign-planning), or cold outreach sales emails (use cold-outreach-sequence).
